type.description: Application type (lookup filter; also used when creating from a source where it defaults to MICROSERVICE)

subscribed.description: Desired subscription state (defaults to true when omitted); false unsubscribes the application from the target tenant

contextPath.description: Context path used when creating the application (defaults to the name)

source.description: Where the application binary (zip) comes from; must resolve to a single file

enabled.description: true: create the Cumulocity CA if it does not exist and enable it. false: disable the CA certificate (it is never deleted)

autoRegistrationEnabled.description: Allow devices presenting certificates signed by the CA to register automatically (left untouched when omitted)

source.description: Where the revocation list CSV files come from (columns SERIALNO and optional DATE; directories are scanned for *.csv by default)

name.description: Name of the command group (used in the output)

actions.description: Shell commands executed in sequence via 'sh -c' from the manifest directory; a failing action skips the rest of the group

name.description: Name of the configuration item (defaults to the filename without extension)

deviceType.description: Restrict the configuration to a device type

url.description: File url of an explicit entry (name without a source); mutually exclusive with content

content.description: Inline file content of an explicit entry (name without a source) which is uploaded as the configuration file; supports ${VAR} expansion and sops encryption; mutually exclusive with url

filename.description: Filename of the uploaded inline content (defaults to the name)

force.description: Replace the configuration item and re-upload its file on every run (like --force but only for this entry) so changed content is applied

source.description: Where the configuration file comes from; without a source the entry declares a single configuration explicitly with name and url or inline content

name.description: Name of the device group; identifies the group among the groups of its parent (or among the root groups)

description.description: Description of the device group (left alone when omitted)

fragments.description: Additional fragments merged into the group managed object (updated when the existing value does not contain the desired values)

groups.description: Child groups linked to this group as child assets

deviceType.description: Restrict the profile to a device type (c8y_Filter.type)

firmware.description: Firmware version included in the profile

software.description: Software versions included in the profile

configuration.description: Configuration items included in the profile

enabled.description: Desired feature state (defaults to true when omitted)

name.description: Override the parsed firmware name (all files become versions of this single firmware item)

deviceType.description: Restrict the firmware to a device type (c8y_Filter.type); supports {name} {version} and {filename} placeholders derived from the artifact filename

version.description: Override the version for all files (defaults to the version parsed from the filename and then the GitHub release tag)

versionPattern.description: Regular expression with a single capture group to extract the version from the filename for custom naming schemes

url.description: Binary url of an explicit entry (name and version without a source); optional - without it the version has an empty url

source.description: Where the firmware images come from; without a source the entry declares a single version explicitly with name and version (and optionally url)

release.description: Which release(s) to use: latest (default) or latest-N for the latest N releases or all or a specific tag

assets.description: Glob patterns matched against release asset filenames (default: *)

includePrereleases.description: Include prereleases when release is latest or all

linkOnly.description: Reference the asset download URL instead of downloading and uploading the binary (public repositories only). Default: true for firmware and false for all other entries. Set false on a firmware entry to upload the binary to Cumulocity

token.description: GitHub API token (falls back to GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN env vars; supports ${VAR} expansion); mutually exclusive with tokenFrom

tokenFrom.description: Take the GitHub API token from an environment variable (env) or a generated value (generate); mutually exclusive with token

run.description: Command executed with 'sh -c' from the manifest directory

pre.description: Commands executed before the sync; a failing pre hook aborts the run

post.description: Commands executed after the sync (also when sections failed); failures are reported but do not abort

sections.description: Hooks executed around individual sections (keyed by section name e.g. software); skipped when the section is excluded by --only

name.description: Configuration item name (must exist in the tenant unless url is set)

type.description: Configuration type of the referenced item

url.description: Explicit file URL skipping the lookup of the configuration item in the tenant; the special values - and none omit the url from the profile entirely

name.description: Firmware name (must exist in the tenant unless url is set)

version.description: Exact firmware version (must exist in the tenant unless url is set); mutually exclusive with versionSelector

versionSelector.description: Select the version from the versions in the tenant by semver: latest or latest-N (e.g. latest-1 for the second latest) or a semver constraint selecting the highest matching version (e.g. ^1.2 or >=1.0 <2.0); mutually exclusive with version

url.description: Explicit binary URL skipping the lookup of the firmware version in the tenant; the special values - and none omit the url from the profile entirely

name.description: Software name (must exist in the tenant unless url is set)

version.description: Exact software version (must exist in the tenant unless url is set); mutually exclusive with versionSelector

versionSelector.description: Select the version from the versions in the tenant by semver: latest or latest-N (e.g. latest-1 for the second latest) or a semver constraint selecting the highest matching version (e.g. ^1.2 or >=1.0 <2.0); mutually exclusive with version

type.description: Software type of the referenced item (disambiguates the lookup and is written to the profile entry)

url.description: Explicit binary URL skipping the lookup of the software version in the tenant; the special values - and none omit the url from the profile entirely

dataType.description: Data type the rule applies to

fragmentType.description: Restrict the rule to documents carrying this fragment (defaults to *)

type.description: Restrict the rule to documents of this type (defaults to *)

source.description: Restrict the rule to documents of this source device ID (defaults to *)

editable.description: Whether the rule is editable in the UI (only written when set)

env.description: Name of an environment variable which holds the value (it must be set and not empty)

generate.description: Name of a generated value (NAME or NAME:LENGTH) stored in the secrets file; the same as ${generate:NAME}

pre.description: Commands executed before the section; a failing pre hook aborts the run

post.description: Commands executed after the section (also when items failed); failures are reported but do not abort

name.description: Override the collection name from the file (only sensible for single-file sources)

source.description: Where the exported SmartREST 2.0 collection JSON files come from (directories are scanned for *.json by default)

name.description: Software name of an explicit entry: a single version declared with name and version (and optionally type and url) instead of packages from a source; mutually exclusive with source

url.description: Binary url of an explicit entry (optional; without it the version has an empty url e.g. for packages which devices install from their package repositories)

namePrefix.description: Prefix added to every parsed software name

type.description: Software type: forces the softwareType for all packages from the source (overrides auto-detection) or sets it for an explicit entry

typeMap.description: Map filename glob patterns to software types (pattern=softwaretype; first match wins)

version.description: Exact version of an explicit entry (used as-is e.g. latest) or an override of the parsed version (useful for single-file sources)

source.description: Where the software packages come from; mutually exclusive with name

path.description: Local file or directory (relative paths are resolved against the manifest directory)

patterns.description: Glob patterns matched against filenames when path is a directory (default: *)

url.description: External URL referenced without uploading a binary

github.description: Pull release assets from a GitHub repository

optional.description: Skip this entry instead of failing when the path does not exist or nothing matches

mode.description: Credential source for other tenants (defaults to serviceUser)

application.description: Name of the placeholder microservice used in serviceUser mode (created if missing; defaults to tenant-sync)

sessionHome.description: Directory containing go-c8y-cli session files for the sessions mode (defaults to $C8Y_SESSION_HOME and then ~/.cumulocity)

current.description: Include the current tenant (defaults to true only when no other selection mode is set)

allChildren.description: Apply to all child tenants of the current tenant (requires parent/management tenant credentials)

tenants.description: Tenants referenced by ID or by domain (entries containing a dot are treated as domains)

selector.description: Select tenants matching criteria (domain glob and/or company name)

credentials.description: How credentials for the other tenants are obtained (defaults to the serviceUser mode)

value.description: Desired value of the tenant option (mutually exclusive with valueFrom)

valueFrom.description: Resolve the value by a named lookup at apply time (mutually exclusive with value)

application.description: Application name resolved to its application ID

device.description: Device name resolved to its managed object ID

env.description: Name of an environment variable which holds the value (it must be set and not empty)

generate.description: Name of a generated value (NAME or NAME:LENGTH) stored in the secrets file; the same as ${generate:NAME}

domain.description: Glob pattern matched against the tenant domain

company.description: Exact company name of the tenant

name.description: Override the certificate name (only sensible for sources resolving to a single certificate); defaults to the certificate subject common name and then the filename

autoRegistrationEnabled.description: Allow devices presenting certificates signed by this certificate to register automatically (left untouched when omitted)

source.description: Where the certificate files come from (PEM with one or more certificates or a single DER/base64 certificate per file; directories are scanned for *.pem and *.crt and *.cer by default)

roles.description: Role names assigned to the group (additive; roles not listed are never removed)

userName.description: Username (login) of the user (defaults to the email)

email.description: Email address of the user (required to create a user; defaults to the userName when it is an email address)

enabled.description: Desired account state (defaults to true when omitted); false disables the user

password.description: Initial password used only when creating the user (never updated afterwards); supports ${VAR} expansion; mutually exclusive with passwordFrom

passwordFrom.description: Take the initial password from an environment variable (env) or a generated value (generate); mutually exclusive with password

sendPasswordResetEmail.description: Send a password reset email when creating the user (requires email; alternative to password)

groups.description: User group names the user is assigned to (additive; memberships not listed are never removed)

targets.description: Which tenants the manifest is applied to (defaults to the current tenant); applying to other tenants requires parent/management tenant credentials

tenantOptions.description: Tenant options to set (created if missing and updated when the value differs)

features.description: Feature toggles to enable or disable for the current tenant

retentionRules.description: Retention rules to ensure exist (matched by dataType/fragmentType/type/source; maximumAge updated when it differs)

certificateAuthority.description: Enable or disable the tenant's Cumulocity certificate authority (CA) certificate

trustedCertificates.description: Trusted device certificates (PEM/DER) to upload into the tenant trust store (matched by fingerprint; name/status/autoRegistrationEnabled updated when they differ)

certificateRevocationLists.description: Certificate revocation entries to upload from CSV files (columns SERIALNO and optional DATE); additive: existing entries are never removed

applications.description: Applications to subscribe to the current tenant (optionally created/uploaded from a source)

deviceGroups.description: Tree of device groups to create/update (a group is identified by its name within its parent; groups are never deleted or unlinked)

userGroups.description: User groups (global roles) to create/update with roles assigned (additive: existing roles are never removed)

users.description: Users to create/update and assign to user groups (additive: existing memberships are never removed)

software.description: Software packages to sync into the software repository

firmware.description: Firmware (OS images) to sync into the firmware repository

configuration.description: Configuration files to sync into the configuration repository

smartrestTemplates.description: SmartREST 2.0 template collections to sync from exported JSON files (one collection per file)

deviceProfiles.description: Device profiles referencing firmware/software/configuration in the tenant

commands.description: Named groups of shell commands run as the last section; actions within a group run in sequence and groups run concurrently

hooks.description: Commands executed before and after the sync and around individual sections (e.g. go-c8y-cli calls)

sops.description: Metadata added by sops to encrypted manifests (tenant-sync decrypts the manifest with the sops CLI before applying it)

title: tenant-sync manifest
description: Declarative description of the desired state of a Cumulocity IoT tenant, applied with the c8y tenant-sync extension
